app.tagline: Preserve the past. Share the future.

language.label: Language
language.title: Make it yours
language.description: Choose your interface language. Your preference is saved on this device.

library.title: A home for game history.
library.description: Organize and verify your digital collection. Keep its story alive, one file at a time.
library.emptyDescription: Choose files or folders to start your local collection.
library.importDescription: Select files or folders. SHA-256 is calculated locally. Originals stay in place; importing does not share them.
library.manifestHint: JSON exports contain catalog hashes and relative paths. Choose a new filename; existing files are preserved.
library.loadedScope: Search, platform filters and totals apply to loaded items only. Load more to include the rest of your collection; indexed size is not deduplicated disk usage.
library.searchPlaceholder: Find a title among loaded items…
library.noMatches: No loaded items match your filters.

tasks.title: Every step, accounted for.
tasks.description: A place to follow imports, integrity checks, and future transfers.
tasks.emptyDescription: Imports and integrity checks will appear here.

settings.title: Your workspace, your way.
settings.description: Choose your language, save your local library, or restore a reviewed backup.

runtime.unavailable: Desktop backend unavailable. Restart the application to retry.

errors.ipcUnavailable: Open the desktop app to use this feature.
errors.contractMismatch: The interface and backend versions are incompatible. Restart with a matching build.
errors.invalidResponse: The backend returned an invalid response.
errors.databaseUnavailable: The local database is unavailable. Restart the app and try again.
errors.databaseTaskFailed: The database operation could not finish.
errors.invalidArgument: Check the supplied values and try again.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.taskNotCancellable: This task cannot be cancelled in its current state.
errors.capabilityUnavailable: This feature is unavailable in the current backend.
errors.sourceUnavailable: A source is empty, unavailable, unsupported, or contains a symbolic link/junction. Check it and select again.
errors.sourceChanged: A file changed during hashing. Close programs using it and select again.
errors.importLimitExceeded: Selection limit exceeded: up to 100 sources, 100,000 files, and 128 folder levels per import.
errors.manifestInvalid: The collection cannot be represented by manifest v1. Check its metadata and relative paths.
errors.manifestVersionUnsupported: This manifest version is unsupported. Use a compatible Game4 build.
errors.manifestWriteFailed: The manifest could not be saved. Choose an unused .json filename in a writable folder.
errors.backupInvalid: This file is not a valid Game4 library backup, violates catalog constraints, or exceeds the 64 MiB / 500,000-record limit.
errors.backupVersionUnsupported: This backup or database schema version is unsupported. Use a compatible Game4 build.
errors.backupWriteFailed: The backup could not be written. Choose an unused .json filename in a writable folder; restoration also requires space for a recovery copy.
errors.libraryBusy: Wait for imports, integrity checks and package exports to finish, then try again.
errors.restoreStale: The restore preview expired or the catalog changed. Select the backup again to review it.
errors.restoreFailed: Restoration could not finish. The current catalog was preserved; any recovery file remains available.
errors.verificationLimitExceeded: This item exceeds the verification limit of 500,000 registered copies.
errors.packageInvalid: This is not a valid Game4∞ v1 package.
errors.packageVersionUnsupported: This package version is not supported. Update Game4∞ to read it.
errors.packageWriteFailed: The package could not be saved. Choose a new .g4 filename and check permissions and free space.
errors.packageIntegrityFailed: A file is missing, unreadable or does not match its reference hash/size. Verify the sources or choose another package.
errors.packageLimitExceeded: This package exceeds supported limits (100,000 files, 1 TiB of payload, or metadata limits).
errors.g4eInvalid: This is not a valid supported .g4e descriptor or torrent reference.
errors.g4eLimitExceeded: The descriptor, torrent or source collection exceeds supported limits.
errors.g4eIntegrityFailed: The original files or selected torrent do not match their reference identities. Originals were not repaired or modified.
errors.g4eWriteFailed: References could not be saved. Choose a new .g4e filename and check permissions and free space. A new torrent companion may remain after a late write failure.
errors.torrentInvalid: This torrent is malformed or uses unsupported metadata. This preview accepts regular public BitTorrent v1 files without padding.
errors.transferLimitExceeded: Transfer limits reached (4 active sessions, 64 session records, 1,024 files or 1 TiB per torrent).
errors.transferFailed: The transfer could not be started or continued. Check sources, free space, port availability and peer connectivity. Any new partial download folder is kept.
errors.transferUnavailable: Transfers or their saved state are unavailable. Local Library operations remain available.

backup.title: Save and restore your library
backup.description: Save a complete catalog backup, including metadata, hashes, paths, and task history. Game files and interface preferences are not included.
backup.privateData: Backups contain private local paths and notes. Keep them in a trusted place. Restored copies require a new integrity check.
backup.restored_one: Library restored: {{count}} item. Previous catalog saved in database/backups as {{recovery}}.
backup.restored_other: Library restored: {{count}} items. Previous catalog saved in database/backups as {{recovery}}.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces the current catalog. A recovery copy is saved first. Game files remain untouched. Wait for imports to finish before continuing.
backup.confirmReplacement: I understand that this backup will replace my current library.

integrity.title: Integrity observations
integrity.scope: Checks all registered copies of this item’s content, including copies in other items. Does not scan for new files.
integrity.issues: Problems found. Review the counts below.
integrity.lastChecked: Latest observation: {{date}}. Files may have changed since.
integrity.completed: Check completed. Review integrity observations in the Library for matching, changed, missing or inaccessible copies.

packages.title: Game4∞ packages
packages.description: Create a portable .g4 from a Library item, or open one to verify every included file.
packages.creating: Creating .g4: reading and checking original files. Large collections can take a while. Keep the app open.
packages.reading: Reading package and verifying SHA-256 for every file. Large packages can take a while.
packages.verified: All included file sizes and SHA-256 hashes match the manifest. This checks consistency, not publisher authenticity.
packages.readOnly: Package inspected. No files were extracted, executed or imported into the Library.

ever.title: Game4 Ever Manifests
ever.description: Create sharing references from a Library item’s originals, or inspect a .g4e offline. Creating a .g4 package is optional.
ever.exportLabel: Export sharing references for {{title}} without converting originals
ever.creating: Checking original SHA-256 and creating torrent pieces. Originals stay in place; no payload copy or .g4 is created.
ever.shareHint: Share both reference files or the magnet. A seeding BitTorrent client is still needed to make the original bytes available. No transmission has started in Game4∞.
ever.descriptorOnly: Descriptor valid. Referenced torrent metadata, source availability and content have not been verified by this open action. No network connection was made.

transfers.title: P2P transfers
transfers.description: Create torrents and magnets, seed originals and discover peers.
transfers.connectionDescription: Connect over IPv4 TCP using an initial peer, optional DHT or selected HTTP/HTTPS/UDP trackers. Local discovery and automatic router port mapping remain off.
transfers.exposure: Starting a seed or download opens a network session and can expose your IP to peers. Downloads also upload received pieces. A completed download stops by default, or continues seeding if you explicitly enable it.
transfers.seedTitle: Create a torrent or seed originals
transfers.sourceHint: The existing imported source is checked and opened read-only. No .g4 conversion or payload copy is needed. Creating the .torrent alone does not start sharing.
transfers.noSource: Import files or a folder into the Library first.
transfers.port: Listening TCP port (0 chooses an available port)
transfers.importHint: Importing only checks metainfo and shows the file list. No network session starts until you choose Download.
transfers.outputHint: Choose a parent folder next. Game4∞ creates a new download subfolder and never overwrites existing files. Stopping keeps received data.
transfers.empty: No transfer sessions. Nothing starts automatically on app launch.
transfers.preparing: Preparing files or updating the session. Large source checks may take a while.
transfers.listening: Listening port: {{port}}. Use this computer’s reachable IP plus this port on the other PC.
transfers.dht: Enable DHT for the next network action
transfers.dhtHint: DHT contacts the public UDP network and can publish your info hash and IP. It needs reachable peers and does not bypass NAT or firewalls. Existing sessions keep their original setting.
transfers.magnetHint: Fetching metadata starts network connections for up to 60 seconds without payload downloads. Use an initial peer, DHT or reviewed trackers. Review the resulting files before selecting a destination. Web sources remain unsupported.
transfers.resolving: Fetching magnet metadata… No payload files are being downloaded.
transfers.useTrackers: Use the listed trackers for the next action
transfers.trackerHint: Review imported addresses before enabling them. Up to 16 trackers, 2,048 characters per URL and 4,096 total. Enabled trackers are contacted on network actions and included in generated magnets/torrents. Trackers receive your IP, info hash and transfer counters; URLs may contain private passkeys. No default public tracker is added.
transfers.keepSeedingHint: Off by default: the download session stops when complete. Enabling keeps sharing received files until you stop the session or close the app. Active downloads can upload verified pieces in either case.
transfers.connected: Connected peers: {{peers}} · Seeders: {{seeders}} · Leechers / other peers: {{leechers}}
transfers.availabilityFull: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peers advertise a complete copy.
transfers.availabilityUnknown: Remote availability is undetermined. No connected seeder has advertised a complete copy; partial peers may still provide all pieces together.
transfers.peerScope: Counts describe this session, not the entire swarm. Other peers include incomplete copies and peers not yet classified. Advertised availability does not authenticate or verify their bytes.
transfers.metricsUnavailable: Live peer and speed observations unavailable while inactive or starting.
transfers.availabilityFull_one: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peer advertises a complete copy.
transfers.availabilityFull_other: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peers advertise a complete copy.
transfers.persistenceHint: Transfer state is saved privately on this computer. Interrupted sessions reopen paused; Resume rechecks local pieces before opening peer connections. Keep the ownership sidecar beside each download folder. Forgetting a row keeps all files but removes its resume record.
transfers.noMatches: No saved transfers match this filter.
transfers.liveScope: Sampled speeds and connected peers refresh about every second. Counts describe this session only.
transfers.staleMetrics: Update unavailable. Byte totals and progress are last known; live speeds and peer counts are hidden.

dashboard.title: Built to outlast.
dashboard.description: Your collection. Your files. A future worth preserving.
dashboard.heroLabel: THE NEXT CHAPTER OF GAME PRESERVATION
dashboard.heroText: Build your archive, check what matters and share on your terms. It all starts on your device.
dashboard.scope: Library metrics cover the first 50 catalog items; sizes count each item, not unique disk usage.
dashboard.partial: More items are available in the Library.
dashboard.preview: Desktop preview. Open Game4∞ to load your local data.
dashboard.empty: Your archive is a blank canvas.
dashboard.emptyText: Import your first files or folder in the Library. Originals stay where they are.
dashboard.noActivity: Your imports and integrity checks will appear here.
dashboard.activityScope: Showing up to 5 of the latest 50 tasks.
dashboard.originalsText: Index and share without mandatory conversion.
dashboard.integrityText: Run manual SHA-256 checks from your Library.
dashboard.networkText: Saved transfers reopen paused. You decide when to resume.
dashboard.transferScope: Current saved sessions. No network sessions are started by this dashboard.
